text: Audit job timeout headroom	UNKNOWN STEP	2026-11-09T13:26:27.7765745Z `timeout-minutes` against the worst measured duration of the same job. A job killed by its cap reports `cancelled`, not `failure` (issue #977), so a cap the work routinely approaches is a false negative waiting to happen (issue #1076).
